theorem stepC_send_frees (c : CfgM) {B : Int} (id : w64) (ps : PState) (ms : List Msg) (Hms : ∀ (m :
    Msg), m ∈ ms → (m.ty = MsgType.preVote ∨ m.ty = MsgType.preVoteResp) ∧ m.src = id) : StepC c id
    B ps [] (psendMsgs ps ms)

theorem stepC_campaignState [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (c : CfgM) {B : Int} (id : w64)
    (s : NState) (pre : Bool) (peers : List w64) (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) (Hnl : s.role ≠
    PRole.leader) (Hin : id ∈ c.voters) (Hnw : uint.Z s.term + 1 < 2 ^ 64) (Hperm : peers.Perm
    (elements (c.voters \ {id}))) (cl : List w8 := []) : StepC c id B (toPState s) [] (toPState
    (have __src := campaignState id s pre peers cl; { term := __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead
    := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes, outbox := __src.outbox, stepfn :=
    __src.stepfn, ticking := __src.ticking, progress := __src.progress, log := __src.log, logst :=
    __src.logst, prvals := pvs, prevote := __src.prevote, gh := __src.gh, rd := __src.rd, lt :=
    __src.lt, pci := __src.pci, isLearner := __src.isLearner, sdr := __src.sdr, cq := __src.cq }))

theorem stepC_record_then_win (c : CfgM) {B : Int} (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) (mt : GMap w64
    w64) (ms : List Msg) (Hty : m.ty = MsgType.voteResp) (Hto : m.dst = id) (Hterm : m.term =
    s.term) (Hrole : s.role = Role.candidate) (Hmt : LeaderMatchOk id { term := s.term, vote :=
    s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := recordVote s.votes m.src !m.reject, outbox :=
    s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd }
    mt) (Hms : ∀ (m' : Msg), m' ∈ ms → ReplOk id (pwinState id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote,
    lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := recordVote s.votes m.src !m.reject, outbox := s.outbox,
    base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd } mt) m') (Hq
    : JQuorum c (granted (recordVote s.votes m.src !m.reject))) (Hnw : plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log +
    1 ≤ B) (Hsn : ∀ (m' : Msg), m' ∈ ms → m'.ty = MsgType.snap → m'.dst ∈ c.voters ∪ c.learners) :
    StepC c id B s ([m] ++ []) (psendMsgs (pwinState id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead :=
    s.lead, role := s.role, votes := recordVote s.votes m.src !m.reject, outbox := s.outbox, base :=
    s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd } mt) ([pselfAck id
    (pwinState id { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes :=
    recordVote s.votes m.src !m.reject, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit :=
    s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd } mt)] ++ ms))

theorem stepC_prevoteRespResult [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (c : CfgM) {B : Int} (id :
    w64) (s : NState) (src : w64) (reject won lost : Bool) (peers : List w64) (pvs : GMap w64
    Progress) (Hpre : s.role = PRole.preCandidate) (Hin : id ∈ c.voters) (Hnw : uint.Z s.term + 1 <
    2 ^ 64) (Hperm : won = true → peers.Perm (elements (c.voters \ {id}))) : StepC c id B (toPState
    s) [] (toPState (have __src := prevoteRespResult id s src reject won lost peers; { term :=
    __src.term, vote := __src.vote, lead := __src.lead, role := __src.role, votes := __src.votes,
    outbox := __src.outbox, stepfn := __src.stepfn, ticking := __src.ticking, progress :=
    __src.progress, log := __src.log, logst := __src.logst, prvals := pvs, prevote := __src.prevote,
    gh := __src.gh, rd := __src.rd, lt := __src.lt, pci := __src.pci, isLearner := __src.isLearner,
    sdr := __src.sdr, cq := __src.cq }))
